sources.snippet: Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct also known as Mistral Small 3 (2501) is a cutting-edge 24B parameter language model from Mistral AI. Designed for efficient local deployment, this instruction-tuned model excels in low-latency tasks such as conversational agents and function calling. Despite its compact size, it delivers performance comparable to models three times larger, supports multiple languages ...
